# Model Aggregation — LLM API Gateway Deployment

## When to use

Load this skill when the user:
- Wants to deploy an LLM API gateway (New API, One API, etc.)
- Needs to aggregate multiple LLM providers behind one unified endpoint
- Wants to expose local models (llama.cpp) alongside cloud providers
- Deploys infrastructure in China without GFW access
- Configures Docker Hub mirrors for Chinese mainland
- Sets up multi-provider routing, failover, and weighted load balancing
- Evaluates API gateway tools for their project

## Tool Selection

| Tool | Stars | Language | License | Best For |
|------|-------|----------|---------|----------|
| **QuantumNous/new-api** | 35k+ | Go | AGPL-3.0 | Full gateway with billing, multi-tenant, Web UI |
| Calcium-Ion/one-api | 20k+ | Go | MIT | Original, lighter weight |
| LiteLLM | 18k+ | Python | MIT | Python-native, proxy mode |
| OpenAI-Forward | 2k+ | Python | MIT | Minimalist forwarding proxy |

**Default choice: New API** — most active community, rich Web UI, billing system, format conversion (OpenAI ↔ Claude ↔ Gemini).

## Deployment: Binary Method (Recommended, No Docker)

New API provides standalone Go binaries (~85MB) on GitHub Releases. No Docker needed, zero config startup with SQLite.

```bash
# Direct download
curl -L -o new-api \
  "https://github.com/QuantumNous/new-api/releases/download/v1.0.0-rc.10/new-api-v1.0.0-rc.10"
chmod +x new-api

# If GitHub slow, use accelerator
curl -L -o new-api \
  "https://ghproxy.com/https://github.com/QuantumNous/new-api/releases/download/v1.0.0-rc.10/new-api-v1.0.0-rc.10"
chmod +x new-api

# Start (SQLite default, port 3000)
./new-api --port 3000 --log-dir ./logs

# Background
nohup ./new-api --port 3000 --log-dir ./logs > new-api.log 2>&1 &
```

Default credentials: `root` / `123456` — **change immediately.**

## Deployment: Docker Method (Production)

### Docker CE Installation (Alibaba Cloud Mirror)

```bash
curl -fsSL https://mirrors.aliyun.com/docker-ce/linux/ubuntu/gpg | apt-key add -
add-apt-repository \
  "deb [arch=amd64] https://mirrors.aliyun.com/docker-ce/linux/ubuntu $(lsb_release -cs) stable"
apt-get update && apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io
service docker start
```

### Docker Hub Mirror Configuration

```bash
mkdir -p /etc/docker
cat > /etc/docker/daemon.json << 'EOF'
{
  "registry-mirrors": [
    "https://docker.1ms.run",
    "https://docker.xuanyuan.me",
    "https://docker.m.daocloud.io"
  ]
}
EOF
systemctl restart docker
```

### Pull and Run

```bash
docker pull calciumion/new-api:latest

docker run -d \
  --name new-api \
  --restart always \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -e TZ=Asia/Shanghai \
  -v /home/jialine/new-api/data:/data \
  calciumion/new-api:latest
```

### Docker-to-Host Networking

When llama.cpp server runs on the host and New API runs in Docker:

| Pattern | Host Address from Container |
|---------|---------------------------|
| Default bridge | `172.17.0.1` |
| Host network mode | `localhost` (add `--network host` to docker run) |
| Custom bridge | Check `ip addr show docker0` |

Test connectivity:
```bash
docker exec new-api curl http://172.17.0.1:8080/health
```

## Connecting Local Models

### llama.cpp Server (OpenAI-Compatible Mode)

```bash
./llama-server \
  -m /path/to/model.gguf \
  --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080 \
  -ngl 0 -c 4096
```

In New API admin panel:
- **Channel Type:** OpenAI
- **Proxy:** `http://127.0.0.1:8080` (binary mode) or `http://172.17.0.1:8080` (Docker mode)
- **Model:** any name (e.g., `qwen3.5-122b`)
- **Key:** anything (llama.cpp server doesn't validate)

## Multi-Provider Aggregation

New API's model mapping: one model name → multiple channels → weighted routing + failover.

1. **Model Management** → create custom model (e.g., `gpt-best`)
2. Add multiple channels of the same type (OpenAI official, DeepSeek, etc.)
3. New API auto-load-balances with weighted random, auto-retries on failure

## GitHub Download Acceleration (China)

Replace `https://github.com/` with:
- `https://ghproxy.com/https://github.com/` (stable)
- `https://mirror.ghproxy.com/https://github.com/` (alternate)

For git clone:
```bash
git clone https://ghproxy.com/https://github.com/QuantumNous/new-api.git
```

## Docker Offline Transfer

When mirror pull fails, transfer image manually:
```bash
# On machine with network
docker pull calciumion/new-api:latest
docker save calciumion/new-api:latest -o new-api.tar
# scp to target
docker load -i new-api.tar
```

## Verification

```bash
# List models
curl http://localhost:3000/v1/models \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-YOUR_TOKEN"

# Chat completion
curl http://localhost:3000/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-YOUR_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "qwen3.5-122b", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "你好"}]}'
```

Generate tokens in admin panel → **Tokens**.

## Resource Budget

| Component | RAM | Storage |
|-----------|-----|---------|
| New API (binary) | ~50MB | ~100MB |
| New API (Docker) | ~100MB | ~100MB |
| llama.cpp + 122B GGUF | ~19GB | ~72GB |

## Pitfalls

1. **AGPL-3.0 license** — New API is AGPL-3.0, not MIT. If integrating into a product (like Panda Agent), the entire product must be AGPL-3.0 compatible. For internal/proxy use this is not an issue.

2. **Docker Hub pull timeout in China** — always configure `registry-mirrors` before `docker pull`. Test with `docker pull hello-world` first.

3. **172.17.0.1 may not exist on all Docker networks** — check with `ip addr show docker0`. On some systems it's `172.18.0.1` or `172.19.0.1`. Use `host` network mode (`--network host`) to avoid this entirely.

4. **GitHub Releases may be slow but not blocked** — binary downloads go through `objects.githubusercontent.com` which is generally accessible in China unlike `github.com` git protocol. If slow, use `ghproxy.com` accelerator.

5. **Default SQLite is fine for < 1000 users** — switch to MySQL only when scaling. SQLite handles concurrent reads well with WAL mode (enabled by default).

6. **New API and Panda Agent can coexist** — they use different ports (3000 vs 8000). Panda Agent can proxy through New API by pointing its providers to `http://localhost:3000/v1` with New API tokens.

## References

- `references/new-api-deploy-guide.md` — Full deployment guide with all three methods, channel configuration, llama.cpp integration, and FAQ
